description: This file defines the WorkActivityStore class, a final class responsible for managing and tracking activities related to jobs and tools within the application. It includes functionality for handling activity states, session management, and icon state derivation, and interacts with external protocols and libraries such as Foundation, Observation, OpenClawKit, OpenClawProtocol, and SwiftUI.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing work activity state, including active jobs and tools, session keys, and icon states.

classes.name: WorkActivityStore.Activity
classes.description: A struct representing an activity, including session key, role, kind, label, start time, and last update time.

methods.name: handleJob
methods.description: Handles job start and end events based on the session key and state string.

methods.name: handleTool
methods.description: Manages tool activity based on phase, name, meta, and arguments, and updates state accordingly.

methods.name: resolveIconState
methods.description: Determines the icon state based on the current activity, with optional override selection.

methods.name: setMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets the main session key for the store.
